item.description:
🚨

Hebrew newspaper Yedioth Ahronoth: The Israeli army and defense industries have tested more than 100 different solutions designed to counter and intercept Hezb’s explosive-laden drones, with some advancing to field trials. The system has been operated as part of field trials, although the Israeli army previously said its effectiveness remains insufficient. At the same time, additional detection systems are being used to provide forces with early warning seconds before a drone attack.
